snippet.title: Your boss of taking advantage of you
snippet.description:
Being good at your job can sometimes turn into a trap 😅
The more capable you are, the more responsibility quietly gets added to your plate 🙃
And before you realize it, you’re carrying work that looks a lot bigger than your title.
Growth at work should come with direction. What you're building toward, what success looks like, and when progress is expected to happen ✅
If those pieces are missing, it’s okay to step back and ask for clarity.
Effort alone doesn’t always change your role. Sometimes the shift only happens when you advocate for it 🙏

#careeradvice #corporate #officepolitics

snippet.title: Instant pot oxtail 인스턴트팟 소꼬리찜 + 부추
snippet.description:
Hosting Lora fam @heejinious & @jimioh6789 and @benitakim in SF was so fun 💕 LOVED having a full house. 

#InstantPot Braised Oxtail (소꼬리찜)
For 2 packs (about 4–5 lb) – 4 adults

Prep
Soak oxtail in cold water 1–2 hours, changing water once. This removes blood.
Parboil 10 minutes, then rinse under cold water and trim excess fat.

Layer in Instant Pot
Bottom aromatics first:
 • 1 apple, sliced
 • 1 onion, sliced
 • 8–10 garlic cloves
 • 1 thumb ginger, sliced
 • 1 tbsp whole peppercorn
 • ¼ cup sake / mirin / soju (optional)

Place the parboiled oxtail on top. You may coat the meat with soybean paste (2 tbsp) 

Cook
High pressure 30 minutes
Natural release 10–15 minutes

If you want richer flavor, open the lid and simmer on sauté 5–10 minutes to reduce the broth.

⸻

Chives Salad (부추무침)
This is the classic pairing with oxtail.

For 1 pack chives

Cut chives into 2–3 inch pieces.

Mix dressing:
 • 1.5 tbsp soy sauce
 • 1 tbsp vinegar
 • 1 tsp sugar or allulose
 • 1 tsp red pepper flakes (고춧가루)
 • 1 tsp minced garlic
 • 1 tsp sesame oil
 • 1 tsp sesame seeds

Toss right before serving so it stays crisp.

⸻

Serving tip
Put the hot oxtail on rice and pile chives salad on top. The fatty richness of the oxtail + acidic chives is the whole point of the dish.

snippet.title: Should you stay for the kids?
snippet.description:
🚨The most dangerous relationship lesson a child can learn is the one they watch at home.
“Stay for the kids” sounds selfless. Like you’re sacrificing for your child.
But children are always watching. They’re learning what love looks like from the relationship they see at home.🫣They notice the tension, the silence, the arguments, the walking on eggshells. Even when we think they don’t.
When a child grows up around constant disrespect or emotional chaos, that becomes the standard they carry into their own relationships one day 🙅🏻‍♀️
Sometimes the bravest thing a parent can do is choose peace, even if that means leaving. 🙏
Because one stable, safe parent can teach a child far more about love than a household full of tension.
One day they’ll understand the courage it took.🙌

#parenting #divorce #singlemom

snippet.title: Your boss of taking advantage of you
snippet.description:
Being good at your job can sometimes turn into a trap 😅
The more capable you are, the more responsibility quietly gets added to your plate 🙃
And before you realize it, you’re carrying work that looks a lot bigger than your title.
Growth at work should come with direction. What you're building toward, what success looks like, and when progress is expected to happen ✅
If those pieces are missing, it’s okay to step back and ask for clarity.
Effort alone doesn’t always change your role. Sometimes the shift only happens when you advocate for it 🙏

#careeradvice #corporate #officepolitics

snippet.title: Instant pot oxtail 인스턴트팟 소꼬리찜 + 부추
snippet.description:
Hosting Lora fam @heejinious & @jimioh6789 and @benitakim in SF was so fun 💕 LOVED having a full house. 

#InstantPot Braised Oxtail (소꼬리찜)
For 2 packs (about 4–5 lb) – 4 adults

Prep
Soak oxtail in cold water 1–2 hours, changing water once. This removes blood.
Parboil 10 minutes, then rinse under cold water and trim excess fat.

Layer in Instant Pot
Bottom aromatics first:
 • 1 apple, sliced
 • 1 onion, sliced
 • 8–10 garlic cloves
 • 1 thumb ginger, sliced
 • 1 tbsp whole peppercorn
 • ¼ cup sake / mirin / soju (optional)

Place the parboiled oxtail on top. You may coat the meat with soybean paste (2 tbsp) 

Cook
High pressure 30 minutes
Natural release 10–15 minutes

If you want richer flavor, open the lid and simmer on sauté 5–10 minutes to reduce the broth.

⸻

Chives Salad (부추무침)
This is the classic pairing with oxtail.

For 1 pack chives

Cut chives into 2–3 inch pieces.

Mix dressing:
 • 1.5 tbsp soy sauce
 • 1 tbsp vinegar
 • 1 tsp sugar or allulose
 • 1 tsp red pepper flakes (고춧가루)
 • 1 tsp minced garlic
 • 1 tsp sesame oil
 • 1 tsp sesame seeds

Toss right before serving so it stays crisp.

⸻

Serving tip
Put the hot oxtail on rice and pile chives salad on top. The fatty richness of the oxtail + acidic chives is the whole point of the dish.

snippet.title: Should you stay for the kids?
snippet.description:
🚨The most dangerous relationship lesson a child can learn is the one they watch at home.
“Stay for the kids” sounds selfless. Like you’re sacrificing for your child.
But children are always watching. They’re learning what love looks like from the relationship they see at home.🫣They notice the tension, the silence, the arguments, the walking on eggshells. Even when we think they don’t.
When a child grows up around constant disrespect or emotional chaos, that becomes the standard they carry into their own relationships one day 🙅🏻‍♀️
Sometimes the bravest thing a parent can do is choose peace, even if that means leaving. 🙏
Because one stable, safe parent can teach a child far more about love than a household full of tension.
One day they’ll understand the courage it took.🙌

#parenting #divorce #singlemom

snippet.title: Divorce isn’t failure
snippet.description:
Some endings are not losses. They’re breakthroughs 🙌
Rebuilding your life takes more strength than staying in something that’s quietly breaking you 🙏
And the women who make that choice deserve respect, not whispers 🙅🏻‍♀️
If you know a woman starting over right now, remind her: courage doesn’t always look loud. Sometimes it looks like walking away and building again 🤍

#divorce #lifeafterdivorce #singlemom
